groups.description: Live urban-mobility platforms this domain is modeled on — useful to see how parking operations, transit fares, and multimodal mobility are productized in practice.

links.title: Arrive — urban mobility platform
links.relevance: The closest full-stack benchmark spanning parking operations, payments, and city services — the platform shape the Municipal Parking Director and Partner Manager are evaluated against.

links.title: Flowbird — urban payments & parking
links.relevance: Connects parking, transit ticketing, and city payments into one operating layer — a direct reference for the Municipal Parking Director's curb-and-payment workflows.

links.title: Masabi — fare payments for public transport
links.relevance: Account-based ticketing and fare-payment APIs that ground the Transit Revenue and Operations Executive's tap, retry, and revenue-assurance jobs.

links.title: Moovit — MaaS app & transit data
links.relevance: Multimodal trip planning and white-label mobility data that shows the consumer journey surface mobility ecosystem partners integrate against.

groups.description: Primary-source urban-mobility research and case studies on how cities use parking and curb management as a strategic policy lever.

links.title: EU Urban Mobility Observatory
links.relevance: The European evidence base for parking-as-policy, smart-parking pilots, and liveability outcomes that frame the Urban Mobility Policy Director's mandate.

links.title: PARK4SUMP — parking management for cities
links.relevance: Reframes parking from enforcement to demand orchestration — the strategic thesis behind the Municipal Parking Director's occupancy and pricing goals.

groups.description: Open data and interoperability standards that determine how parking, curb, and transit systems exchange information across operators.

links.title: GTFS — General Transit Feed Specification
links.relevance: The de-facto open standard for transit data that the Transit Revenue Executive and ecosystem partners depend on for multimodal integration.

links.title: CDS — Curb Data Specification (OMF)
links.relevance: An open standard for managing and pricing curb space — directly relevant to the Municipal Parking Director modeling curb inventory alongside classic parking stock.

groups.description: Resources aimed at the business buyers and integration partners that consume mobility services programmatically.

links.title: Arrive — fleets & businesses
links.relevance: Centralized billing and employee-parking controls that mirror the Fleet Mobility and Expense Manager's spend-control and policy-automation jobs.
